name: dalton-research-all
description: Federated cross-library research connector with per-source capability checks, partial-failure status, and prefix-dispatched document reading.

dalton_research_all.description: Federated search and prefix-dispatched read across currently enabled internal research sources.
dalton_research_all.instruction: Use `search(query=..., limit=...)` to screen across all enabled research sources at once (returns `source_status` and `status='partial'` when any enabled source times out or degrades). Use `read(document='<prefix>:<id>')` (or `get_document`) to fetch full text or image metadata; each source is checked against deployment capabilities on every call.
